name: uora
description: UORA Publications — international academic publishing platform (React SPA + Express API).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix web install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.legacy:build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
